content: Nintendo’s classic SNES console now has its own ChatGPT client, and it's accelerated by the Super FX 2 chip.

title: One gigabyte of Wikipedia losslessly compressed to 105.39MB with self-learning AI transformer model
content: Tufa Labs’ tufazip compresses 1GB of Wikipedia to 105.39MB with a 163M-parameter Transformer as its only predictor, on two Nvidia B200s.

content: Now's your chance to own a massive 49-inch ultrawide QD-OLED gaming monitor now that it's hit a new all-time low price on Amazon for Black Friday.

title: Elon Musk revisits Tesla Shanghai factory after 3 years, praises China manufacturing
content: Tesla CEO Elon Musk made a whirlwind 24-hour visit to China, traveling to Shanghai on November 19 after concluding activities related to the APEC meetings in Shenzhen. He visited Tesla's Shanghai Gigafactory to meet with the Asia-Pacific and China teams, praising their manufacturing and execution capabilities while providing no update on the timeline for expanding Full Self-Driving (FSD) access in China.

title: Trump says Jensen Huang should apologize and return to Nvidia
content: U.S. President Donald Trump said Friday that Jensen Huang should apologize and be allowed to return as Nvidia's chief executive. It was the second time this week Trump backed Huang publicly, and it came three days after Nvidia's board said it would not reinstate him.

title: SolidWizard sees AI, semiconductor orders through 2027
content: Rising investment in AI, semiconductors, and high-performance computing is driving demand for advanced software, giving 3D digital design and AI solutions provider SolidWizard Technology strong order visibility from AI and semiconductor customers through 2027. SolidWizard reported consolidated revenue of NT$1.328 billion (US$40.4 million) for the first three quarters of 2026, up 13.61% year-over-year.

title: Axiomtek restructures for physical AI, expands global customer reach
content: Industrial PC (IPC) maker Axiomtek sustained growth in Q3 2026, reporting quarterly revenue of NT$2.779 billion (US$84.6 million), up 11.5% quarter-over-quarter and 59.32% year-over-year, while its operating margin rose to 13.09%. The company attributed the growth to demand for edge computing, industrial IoT, and AI, as well as more key accounts shifting to direct engagement.

title: Micron labor dispute in Taiwan heats up as premier calls for worker protection
content: Micron Technology's labor dispute in Taiwan has intensified over its incentive-pay system, raising concerns that the standoff could undermine foreign investment confidence as Idaho Governor Brad Little visits the island. Premier Jung-tai Cho called for a settlement that protects workers while ensuring stable operations for the company.
